::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2022 by Manish Srivastava with co-founder Jatin Gupta; headquartered in Bengaluru (HSR Layout) with an R&D centre in Udupi (about 30 staff, Dec 2025). Raised $2M from Bluehill Capital after its DLI approval. Its first SPARSH chip (ECG) taped out on TSMC 65nm in April 2026 and has been validated; v2 adds PPG, bio-impedance and temperature.
:::

## What does this firm design?

SPARSH ultra-low-power biosensing SoCs for medical wearables; v1 captures ECG, v2 targets multi-vital monitoring.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 3/5:** Ultra-low-power biosensing analog front-end SoC for medical wearables.
- **IP ownership 3/5:** Own SPARSH SoC design; IP mix not detailed.
- **Design completeness 4/5:** SPARSH v1 ECG chip taped out on TSMC 65nm in April 2026 and validated.
- **Market readiness 2/5:** Validated v1 silicon, no customers yet; v2 multi-vital chip still to come.
